label: Freeze column
intent: The sheet scrolls under a frozen column. Light: the scrolling column slides left and fades out under the frozen boundary while the next column slides in from the right in lockstep, overshoots a little and snaps into place. Strong: two flicks, one column each: the first stops short, the second lands with a bigger overshoot and a settle. The frozen column and the divider never move.

frame.//: v1 Solid is the frame ring plus the divider at 2.6, with both columns open

prev-bar.//: hidden at rest: a copy of the scrolling column that takes its place at frame 1 (same pixels) and scrolls away under the frozen boundary

motion.//: Columns are 5 apart and move in lockstep: the leaving copy goes 0 to -5 while the scrolling column comes in from +5. Every hand-off happens with both at the same pixels.
